name: DESOXIMETASONE
indications_original: Desoximetasone cream, USP 0.25% is indicated for the relief of the inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses.
contraindications_original: Apply a thin film of desoximetasone cream, USP 0.25% to the affected skin areas twice daily. Rub in gently.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Desoximetasone cream, USP 0.25% is supplied in 15 gram (NDC 71656-087-15) and 60 gram (NDC 71656-087-60) tubes.
                  
                       Store at 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F) [See USP Controlled Room Temperature].

adverseReactions_original: Desoximetasone cream, USP 0.25% is contraindicated in those patients with a history of hypersensitivity to any of the components of the preparation
